findings.justification: The operating margin decreased by approximately 157 basis points (from 24.26% to 22.69%) in fiscal 2026 compared to fiscal 2025. This deterioration in operating margin contradicts the assertion that P&G managed its costs well, as effective cost management would typically maintain or improve operating margins.

findings.key_quote: Operating income decreased $703 million, or 3%, to $19.7 billion
findings.justification: Operating income decreased from $20,451 million in FY2025 to $19,748 million in FY2026, a decline of $703 million or 3%. This absolute decrease in operating income contradicts the claim of managing costs well during fiscal 2026.

findings.key_quote: Operating income decreased $703 million, or 3%, to $19.7 billion as the increase in net sales was more than offset by the decrease in gross margin and increase in SG&A spending. The operating margin decreased 160 basis points to 22.7%
findings.justification: This passage explicitly states that for fiscal 2026, operating income decreased by $703 million and operating margin decreased by 160 basis points, primarily due to decreased gross margin and increased SG&A spending. This deterioration in profitability metrics contradicts the assertion of managing costs well.

findings.key_quote: Overhead costs as a percentage of net sales were unchanged as wage inflation headwinds and restructuring spending were offset by productivity savings.
findings.justification: This shows that overhead costs as a percentage of sales remained flat because productivity savings offset wage inflation and restructuring spending. While this demonstrates some cost management efforts, it only addresses one component (overhead) and shows no improvement, making it insufficient to decide whether overall cost management was 'well' managed.

findings.key_quote: Productivity-driven cost savings delivered 160 basis points of benefit to SG&A as a percentage of net sales.
findings.justification: This shows P&G achieved 160 basis points of productivity savings in SG&A. While this demonstrates positive cost management efforts, it is only one component of overall cost management and does not decide whether costs were managed 'well' overall, especially given the overall operating margin decline.

findings.key_quote: In fiscal 2026, the Company incurred incremental restructuring charges of $903 million after tax under the program.
findings.justification: This states that P&G incurred $903 million in after-tax restructuring charges in fiscal 2026 as part of a portfolio and productivity plan. While restructuring charges are a cost, they are typically considered one-time investments to improve future cost structure rather than evidence of poor ongoing cost management. This is context but does not decide whether overall cost management was good or poor.

findings.key_quote: The Company incurred over half of the costs under this plan in fiscal 2026, with the remainder expected to be incurred in fiscal 2027.
findings.justification: This confirms that P&G incurred over half of the $1.5-2.0 billion restructuring costs in fiscal 2026. While this represents significant costs incurred, restructuring costs are typically viewed as strategic investments to improve future cost structure rather than evidence of poor cost management. This provides context but does not decide the assertion.

findings.key_quote: In June 2025, the Company announced a portfolio and productivity plan to streamline its portfolio and organization to improve its cost structure and invest in growth.
findings.justification: This describes management's announced plan and intent to improve cost structure, not the actual results of cost management in fiscal 2026. Management intent does not decide whether costs were actually managed well during the period.

findings.key_quote: Our objective is to drive productivity improvements across all elements of the statement of earnings and balance sheet, including cost of goods sold, marketing and promotional spending, overhead costs and capital spending.
findings.justification: This describes P&G's objective and strategy for productivity improvements, not the actual results achieved in fiscal 2026. Management objectives and strategies do not decide whether costs were actually managed well during the period.
